summary: Iteration 8 - Tested 4 new features: 1) Emergent badge removal, 2) Test mode toggle in admin settings, 3) OTP 1234 behavior based on test_mode, 4) Module CRUD with ZIP upload. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend tests verified test mode toggle visibility and hint hiding behavior.

emergent_badge_removal: No 'Made with Emergent' badge found in index.html or rendered page
test_mode_toggle: Admin Settings has 'Тестовый режим' toggle with data-testid='settings-test-mode'
otp_1234_behavior: OTP code 1234 is REJECTED when test_mode=false (returns 400 Invalid code)
OTP code 1234 is ACCEPTED when test_mode=true
test_hints_visibility: Admin login page hides test data 'admin@taxi.local / admin123' when test_mode=false
Admin login page shows test data when test_mode=true
Customer auth page hides test hint 'Для тестирования используйте код: 1234' when test_mode=false
Customer auth page shows test hint when test_mode=true
module_crud: POST /api/admin/modules creates new module with enabled=true
module_zip_upload: Non-ZIP files are rejected with 400 error

critical_code_review_comments: Test mode implementation is correct - defaults to true, properly checks in verify_code and reset_pin_verify endpoints
Module CRUD properly handles archive file deletion when module is deleted
Public settings endpoint correctly exposes test_mode without requiring auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 features fully tested: 1) Emergent badge removed from index.html, 2) Test mode toggle in admin settings works correctly, 3) OTP 1234 is rejected when test_mode=false and accepted when test_mode=true, 4) Module CRUD with ZIP upload works correctly. All tests pass. test_mode is currently set to true.
